## What's wrong

A clear description of the problem.

## Page / section

Which page (`index.html`, `privacy.html`, ...) and which section?

## Expected vs actual

What did you expect to see, and what did you see instead?

## Browser

Browser and version (e.g. Chrome 128, Safari 17). Only relevant for rendering/layout issues.

## Screenshot

If applicable, add a screenshot.
